title: lithocarpus rouletii
intro: Lithocarpus rouletii, commonly known as Roulet's tanbark oak, is a species of evergreen tree in the beech family. This plant is prized for its bark, which has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Lithocarpus rouletii include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities, which can help protect against chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial and anti-cancer properties, as well as its ability to modulate the immune system.
